Yuhan Xiao

About

Hi everyone, I’m Yuhan! I’m currently a second-year ScM in Biostatistics student at Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. My research interests focus on leveraging real-world evidence (RWE) and clinical trial data to address pressing health challenges.

I graduated with a B.S. in Honors Mathematics from the University of Michigan, where I first developed a strong foundation in quantitative analysis. After graduating, I worked as a statistical programmer specializing in health policy at Acumen, LLC. During this time, I discovered my passion for data analysis and public health. Most recently, I further honed my skills as a summer HEOR analyst intern at Analysis Group, where I conducted statistical analyses using claims, survey, and electronic health records (EHR) data. Currently, I am a graduate research assistant at the Johns Hopkins School of Medicine in oncology survival analysis.

Outside of school, I enjoy walking in nature, listening to music, and learning Spanish.

Education

ScM in Biostatistics | Johns Hopkins University
B.S. in Honors Mathematics | University of Michigan, Ann Arbor

Programming Experience

R, Python, SAS, SQL
